title: Avoid an empty read-record clause in same-session omission notices
outcome: A same-session notice with unread records and no read records reports the unread boundary without '0 entries ... ()'.
acceptance: When the same-session brief has unread records and no read records left out, its cut notice reports the unread boundary and contains neither 'The host read 0 entries' nor an empty '()'; a test covers it.
The full gate passes on the master tree that contains the change.

completion.summary: Removed the empty read-record clause from same-session omission notices while preserving the unread boundary. Fresh independent evaluation 9ed294fb970748afbb19e6f69f9bd592 passed both criteria on the landed master tree.
